params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$src='C:\Users\Xxkan\AppData\Local\Temp\mhw-agentcontrol-provider-fix2'
$dest='C:\Users\Xxkan\AppData\Local\Temp\mhw-agentcontrol-provider-fix3'
if(Test-Path $dest){Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $dest}
if(-not (Test-Path $src)){throw 'provider-fix2 source clone missing'}
git clone --no-hardlinks $src $dest
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
git -C $dest remote set-url origin https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git
git -C $dest fetch origin main feature/agent-control-plane-v2-20260928
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
git -C $dest checkout -B feature/agent-control-plane-v2-20260928 origin/feature/agent-control-plane-v2-20260928
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
$original=(git -C $dest rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
$main=(git -C $dest rev-parse origin/main).Trim()
git -C $dest merge --no-edit origin/main
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){git -C $dest status --short; exit $LASTEXITCODE}
$reconciled=(git -C $dest rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
if((git -C $dest status --porcelain)){throw 'wrapper reconciliation left dirty worktree'}
$promptPath=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'agentcontrol-provider-fix3-prompt.txt'
$prompt=@'
You are implementing the already-claimed narrow PR #59 Agent Control release blocker in the current reconciled workspace. SOURCE EDITS ONLY: do not run git merge/commit/reset/rebase/checkout. The wrapper has already reconciled current main and will commit after you finish. You may use read-only git status/diff/log.

OBJECTIVE
Fix the two independent-review blockers, without touching unrelated product code:
1) real heaven2 control/credential authority -> heaven heavy-worker execution through the established Heaven Local Bridge private GitHub relay;
2) remove production use of --approve-for-me and pin a safe Codex launch contract.

VERIFIED RUNTIME CONTRACT — USE THIS, DO NOT GUESS
- Relay protocol: chatgpt-heaven-bridge-v2.
- Private relay Git branch: heaven-bridge.
- A dedicated relay checkout on heaven2 is configured by AGENT_CONTROL_HEAVEN_RELAY_DIR. The provider must NOT switch the main repo checkout and must fail closed if this path is absent, dirty in unrelated ways, not on heaven-bridge, not the expected private origin, or cannot synchronize.
- Queue file: heaven-bridge/queue/<job-id>.json.
- Typical envelope: {id,source:"chatgpt-heaven-bridge-v2",created_at,ttl_seconds,action,params,priority}.
- Status: heaven-bridge/status/<job-id>.json with state/action/host/worker_version/protocol/updated_at/exit_code?.
- Result: heaven-bridge/results/<job-id>.json with status,exit_code,started_at,finished_at,host,action plus stdout/stderr/data.
- Worker host must be exactly heaven and protocol exactly chatgpt-heaven-bridge-v2. A fresh heartbeat at heaven-bridge/status/heartbeat.json is required before dispatch.
- Provider queue/result publication must use the dedicated relay checkout with serialized git operations and bounded pull --rebase/push retries. Do not put credentials/tokens in job JSON or logs.
- Relevant actions:
  * proc_run params {shell:"powershell",cwd,timeout_seconds,command}
  * fs_write params {path,content,mode}
  * fs_read_binary params {path,offset,length}
  * job_status params {job_id}
  * cancel params {job_id}
- Remote Agent Control work should use a local lightweight orchestrator process on heaven2 so existing controller PID ownership/restart/orphan semantics still fail closed. Heavy Codex/test execution is on heaven.
- The orchestrator may create an isolated remote worktree/clone on heaven with proc_run, write the rendered prompt with fs_write, run Codex there using the VERIFIED CLI:
  codex -a never -s workspace-write exec --skip-git-repo-check -C <workdir> -
  Never --approve-for-me, danger-full-access, or dangerous bypass flags.
- Network is not guaranteed inside Codex. Prepare/fetch the remote workspace through proc_run outside Codex before launching it.
- For repository-writing tasks, preserve current explicit per-task authorization. Heaven writes must remain blocked unless repositoryWriteAuthorized=true.
- To return code without making heaven the credential authority, have the remote side produce a binary git patch after execution, fetch it with fs_read_binary, apply it to the already-created local Agent Control worktree on heaven2, and commit locally there. Do not require a push from heaven.
- If a remote task only produces textual output and no patch, preserve that output as evidence; do not invent a successful branch change.
- Remote failed/cancelled/stale/unknown/unproven results must NEVER map to done/integration-eligible.

PLACEMENT
- Agent Control itself remains restricted to heaven2 for engineering autopilot.
- Heavy roles/work (main/support/review/testing/integration/recovery and autopilot implementation/verification/review/repair steps) with machine auto should choose heaven only when the provider is configured and fresh/healthy.
- Explicit machine local/heaven2 remains local for control-only/user-requested local tasks.
- Explicit machine heaven requires provider health and existing machine repository-write policy.
- If provider unavailable/stale, fail closed before side effects with a useful blocker; do not silently run heavy work on heaven2.

LOCAL FALLBACK
- If direct local Codex execution remains supported for explicit local work, exact argv must use global flags before exec:
  -a never -s workspace-write exec --json --skip-git-repo-check -C <worktree> -o <lastMessage> ... -
- Remove --approve-for-me completely from production launch code.

TESTS REQUIRED
Add deterministic tests proving:
a) heaven2 + configured fresh provider routes auto heavy work to heaven, not heaven2;
b) unavailable/stale/malformed provider fails closed with no fake success;
c) explicit local/control-only work remains local;
d) exact local launch argv has -a never and -s workspace-write before exec and contains no --approve-for-me/danger-full-access/bypass;
e) remote failed/cancelled/stale/unknown cannot become success/integration-eligible;
f) heaven repo writes still require per-task authorization;
g) bridge request IDs/result identity/protocol/host are validated before acceptance;
h) no public listener or secret-bearing relay payload is introduced.

Keep existing lease/capacity/stop/restart/orphan/autonomy/routing-manifest behavior. Prefer a focused module under tools/agent-control/lib plus a small helper runner if needed rather than scattering transport logic.

DOCUMENTATION
Update tools/agent-control/README.md and CONTROL_PLANE.md only for behavior actually implemented: env/config, health preconditions, failure semantics, operator setup of a dedicated relay checkout.

VERIFY YOUR SOURCE EDITS
Run from tools/agent-control:
npm.cmd run check
npm.cmd test
Fix failures. Do not commit; wrapper will independently rerun gates and commit.

At the end print a concise summary of changed files, provider behavior, exact tests, and any remaining blocker. Do not claim completion if the provider cannot actually dispatch/poll/return authoritative results.
'@
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($promptPath,$prompt,[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $promptPath | codex -a never -s workspace-write exec --skip-git-repo-check -C $dest -
$codexExit=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Output ('CODEX_EXIT='+$codexExit)
if($codexExit -ne 0){git -C $dest status --short; exit $codexExit}
if(-not (git -C $dest status --porcelain)){throw 'Codex produced no source changes'}
Push-Location (Join-Path $dest 'tools\agent-control')
& npm.cmd run check
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){Pop-Location; exit $LASTEXITCODE}
& npm.cmd test
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){Pop-Location; exit $LASTEXITCODE}
Pop-Location
$changed=@(git -C $dest diff --name-only)
git -C $dest add tools/agent-control
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
git -C $dest -c user.name='Agent Control Release Integrator' -c user.email='agent-control@local' commit -m 'Route Agent Control heavy workers through Heaven Bridge'
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
$final=(git -C $dest rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
$clean=((git -C $dest status --porcelain).Length -eq 0)
$art='C:\Users\Xxkan\HeavenBridge\artifacts'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $art | Out-Null
$patch=Join-Path $art 'release-20260929-agentcontrol-provider-fix3.patch'
git -C $dest diff --binary $reconciled..HEAD | Set-Content -LiteralPath $patch -Encoding utf8
$evidence=[ordered]@{
 repo_path=$dest
 refreshed_main_sha=$main
 original_pr_head_sha=$original
 reconciled_parent_sha=$reconciled
 final_head_sha=$final
 changed_files=$changed
 tests=@(
  @{command='npm.cmd run check';result='PASS'},
  @{command='npm.cmd test';result='PASS'}
 )
 implementation_summary='Reconciled PR #59 with current main, implemented Heaven Bridge provider/placement and safe Codex launch contract, verified and committed locally; no push from heaven.'
 remaining_blockers=@()
 worktree_clean=$clean
}
$json=$evidence|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $art 'release-20260929-agentcontrol-provider-fix3.json'),$json+[Environment]::NewLine,[System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false))
Write-Output 'BEGIN_RELEASE_RESULT'
Write-Output $json
Write-Output 'END_RELEASE_RESULT'
Write-Output ('FINAL_HEAD='+$final)
Write-Output ('RECONCILED_PARENT='+$reconciled)
git -C $dest status --short --branch
exit 0

purpose: Corrected PR #59 provider repair: wrapper owns Git reconciliation/commit; Codex remains approval-never workspace-write and edits source only.
